p.i: Manala:tu Phæbo Musisque canentibus Ɛna Inuidiam, Philomela,moue,magnóque nepoti Pleiones.nec tu porrò tamen omnibus istis, Nec senibus cygnis, quando sua funera mæren Inuideas arguta modos. Te nulla sonora Hydraulis moueat,nec acuto carmina cantu, Quanuis mille gemant media de nocte per alta Auia,sylvarúmque procul Ɛocalis imago Respondet longùm fractas ad sydera Ɛoces: Nec qua multiplices syrinx argentea cantus Follibus increpitans animata tumentibus edit: Edit inæquales digitis pulsantibus Ɛrgens Multisono clangore tubas,animáque sonante, Nunc lituum simulans, nunc tympana , sistra tubámque Aut cytharam,strepitúmque,lyra, crotalosq; loquaces: Mille licèt geminent centum discrimina Ɛocum Cymbalâque organâque : haud Ɛnquam tamen omnia possint Vallibus his æquare tuas,Philomela,querelas. Sed tibi,sed primis semper noua frondibus arbos Frondeat,Ɛmbrosa latis sub collibus Anna, Hic ubi lenta suas Loza ludentibus Ɛndis Miscet,& hinc iuncto Lozanná nomine dicunt. Ergo age,Ɛiue,precor,nobis per frondea Iura Confraga,Ɛiue,precor,lògos Philomela per annos: Iste tuus,mi Beza,tuas qui sæpe camœnas Admirans,sterili dixit conuitia Musa,

page.notes: The page is a scan with a left-edge shadow; the italic text is reproduced as far as legible. Several words are uncertain and may contain errors, notably "Ɛna", "Ɛocalis", "Ɛrgens", "Loza" and "Lozanná", which were read approximately. Words such as "Hunc" at the lower right are cut off and marked as the catchword.
